aboutGame.title: What is 3 Years Sword Warriors?
paragraphs: 3 Years Sword Warriors is a fast-paced fantasy sword combat adventure on Roblox. Players face off against relentless waves of enemies, collect and upgrade hundreds of legendary blades, summon powerful companion heroes, and explore diverse fantasy worlds ranging from mystical forests to celestial realms.

With deep progression mechanics including the World 2 Sword Activation system, customizable hero ornaments, multi-tier rune enhancement up to level 16, and challenging endless raid modes, our community wiki provides verified stats, drop tables, and progression guides to help you become the ultimate warrior.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about 3 Years Sword Warriors.

items.question: What is 3 Years Sword Warriors?
items.answer: 3 Years Sword Warriors is a fantasy sword-fighting adventure on Roblox where players defeat enemy waves, upgrade swords, summon heroes, and explore diverse worlds with unique boss encounters.

items.question: How do I redeem 3 Years Sword Warriors codes?
items.answer: Open 3 Years Sword Warriors on Roblox, open the in-game Settings menu, locate the code redemption field, paste your active code, and click Redeem to receive keys, gems, and boosts.

items.question: Which heroes should beginners prioritize in 3 Years Sword Warriors?
items.answer: Beginners in 3 Years Sword Warriors should prioritize EXP Farmer and Gem Farmer heroes early on to accelerate leveling and currency generation before investing in high-tier damage dealers.

items.question: How does weapon star upgrading work in 3 Years Sword Warriors?
items.answer: Weapons in 3 Years Sword Warriors scale from 0-star to 5-star upgrades, significantly multiplying base attack power and enabling players to clear higher-difficulty stages and bosses.

items.question: Where can I find active boss raids in 3 Years Sword Warriors?
items.answer: In 3 Years Sword Warriors, you can access boss raids via the Raid Lobby to upgrade runes up to level 16, purchase vital buffs from the Rune Shop, and take on Nightmare mode.
